Game Overview

Galactic Assault is a shooter title where pilot your starfighter through relentless cosmic battles, unleashing explosive combos and collecting game-changing upgrades. Face waves of enemy drones before confronting a massive, challenging boss. Experience the adrenaline-pumping action of space warfare in this intense, fast-paced shooter.
